title: TPG-led consortium to acquire Aseem Infra Finance; CAM, Linklaters, Trilegal, SAM advise
description: A TPG-led consortium, consisting of GIC and ICICI Bank, are set to acquire 100% of the share capital of Aseem Infrastructure Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, from National Investment and Infrastructure Fund II, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation and the Government of India.Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised TPG on this fundraise.The transaction team was led by Iqbal Khan (Senior Partner) and Ashid Basheer (Partner), with assistance from Pranav Tolani (Principal Associate) and Su
